parole.significato: mullet (several fish species, and especially Mugil cephalus)
parole.testo: * In Egypt, the name of the fish is said to come from Coptic ⲫⲟⲣⲓ (phori, “Mugil cephalus”) – in Bohairic, also ϥⲟⲣⲓ (fori), while in Sahidic it is ⲃⲱⲣⲉ (bōre); however, the name is also used in Morocco and Lebanon, and the relation with Japanese 鰡 / 鯔 (bora) denoting the same species of fish remain
